en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a tram (number 412) in front of a series of ornate, late 19th to early 20th-century European buildings. There is a business sign reading 'C. Friedrich Hermsdorf' on one building. In the background, terraced vineyards cover the hillsides, and a notable baroque-style religious building or pilgrimage church sits atop a hill. Telephone poles and early 20th-century urban features are visible.
